dimensions.description: A complete satisfied result within the command's actual proof boundary.
A blocking finding remains distinct from advisory information.
Advisory information does not become an enforcing gate pass.
No policy, no entries and no filter matches retain their separate meanings.
Partial inventory or scanner coverage cannot look complete.
Stale source, policy, plan or target cannot be reused as current proof.
Unsupported subjects or artifact generations remain explicit.
Invalid configuration or policy remains distinct from instrument failure.
A tool or artifact I/O failure remains distinct from an evaluated domain outcome.
A deterministic primary action retains its exact argv and proof boundary.
Repository judgment is not replaced by an invented preferred action.
Read-only commands and their observed non-effects remain explicit.
Candidate artifact writes name their exact owned paths.
Live mutations name their exact owned paths and rollback boundary.
Targeted evidence does not stand for full proof.
Human, JSON, receipt and summary outputs agree when applicable.
TTY, non-TTY, quiet and file output preserve terminal safety.
The selected installed binary is exercised outside the source checkout.

qualification_gaps: the first-family reader cannot satisfy the full A-C, diff-D and #3882 denominator
JSON/detail/sidecar readback does not execute human, quiet, file, TTY or installed-entrypoint parity cases
runtime resolved-configuration, selected sensor-profile and same-evaluation artifact-set bindings remain incomplete (#3876/#3880/#3885)
expected-context custody, installation authority and final experience/qualification consumption remain outside this reader (#3151/#2501)
source-generation and candidate/install mappings are caller-pinned declarations; binary digest readback alone does not authenticate a build or installation
before/after snapshots cover the controlled fixture outside target and the blocked-output canary; they are not a sandbox or a claim about all host filesystem effects
supplied candidate/install identities are bound declarations; their existing installation receipt and custody authorities were not replayed
claim_boundary: Native readback checks retained bytes, expected context, selected fixture facts and the existing typed command projections. It does not rerun the scan, install or execute a candidate, authenticate a worker, select policy, authorize publication, or establish complete release qualification. A valid selected observation can coexist with Partial qualification.
